steps.text: Talk to Vestri just north of Catherby.
choices: I was wondering what was down those stairs?
If you were my friend I wouldn't mind it.
And how am I meant to do that?

steps.text: Pick the garlic up on the table in Seers' Village. If it is not there it spawns about every 30 seconds.
Enter McGrubor's Woods via the northern entrance.
choices: Be careful of the Guard Dogs (level 44). They are aggressive!

steps.text: Use your spade on the red vines to gather 1 Red Vine Worm.
Enter Hemenster with your fishing pass.
Talk to Grandpa Jack to get a fishing rod.
choices: Can I buy one of your fishing rods?
Very fair, I'll buy that rod!

steps.text: Speak to Bonzo to start the competition.
Speak to Bonzo again after you have caught the winning fish.
choices: I have this big fish. Is it enough to win?

steps.text: Catch the winning fish at the fishing spot near the pipes.

Speak to Grandpa Jack to get a fishing rod.
You can leave McGrubor's Woods via the northern entrance.
choices: Can I buy one of your fishing rods?
Very fair, I'll buy that rod!

steps.text: Bring Vestri just north of Catherby the trophy.
Enter Hemenster with your fishing pass.
Gather 1 Red Vine Worm in McGrubor's Woods.
